tips.text: Run Tier 5 Mother bounties for standing; two or three runs cap your daily Entrati standing.
Stockpile Grandmother Tokens instead of cashing every family token for standing; Seriglass Shards need them and they skip the daily cap.
Over-farm Mother Tokens on free days and cash them in on later resets; they do not expire.
Check Grandmother's Mend the Family trades each visit; they rotate every eight hours and pay family tokens for spare Deimos resources and fish parts.
Grab common Cambion Drift pickups during bounties and Isolation Vaults; Father trades them for tokens.
Budget one Seriglass Shard per Entrati weapon plus one for the Rank 5 sacrifice.
Expect a Fortuna and Cetus detour for the Travocyte and Coprite Alloy blueprints if you never touched them.
Plan on finishing across several daily resets; the standing cap is the gate, not skill.
